name: Enchanted Wilds
notes: Set-level parameters as of 18.1. Nothing here is 'verified' yet: odds and pool sizes come from a third-party site and must be checked against the in-game tooltip before they count as verified.

shop_odds.note: Percent per cost tier 1..5 by player level. CONFLICT at level 7: the table the player sent on 2026-10-18 gives [16,30,43,10,1]; seemeta gives [19,30,40,10,1]. Kept seemeta until the in-game tooltip decides. All other levels agree.

champions_per_cost.note: Should be cross-checked against the champion list once it is added.

shop_slots.source: long-standing TFT shop size; not checked for Set 18
shop_slots.note: Champion slots in a shop without a Wisp. See shop_rules.wisp_slot.

reroll_cost.source: long-standing TFT value; not checked for Set 18

xp_purchase.source: long-standing TFT value; not checked for Set 18

passive_xp_per_round.source: player report (Bahadir, 2026-10-18): the game gives 2 XP every round

xp_to_next_level.source: player report (Bahadir, 2026-10-18), table copied from an internet source; to be checked in-game
xp_to_next_level.note: Key = current level, value = XP needed to reach the next level. 1->2 is automatic. Level 8 was said to be lowered to 56 by a patch (patch not named). 9->10 and 8->9 both 68 looks odd; check.

max_level.note: shop_odds lists level 11; it may only be reachable with an augment.

base_income.note: Gold paid at the start of each round, before interest, streak and win gold. 5 from 2-2 on.

interest_per_10_gold.source: long-standing TFT value; not checked for Set 18

interest_cap.source: long-standing TFT value; not checked for Set 18

streak_gold.note: [[min streak length, bonus gold]]: 2-4 -> +1, 5 -> +2, 6+ -> +3. Same for win and loss streaks.

pvp_win_gold.note: Paid when the player combat is won, before interest is computed.

wisp_slot.source: Riot patch 18.1 notes ('Wisps appear in every other shop') https://teamfighttactics.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/game-updates/teamfight-tactics-patch-18-1 ; rightmost slot: https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/TFT:Enchanted_Wilds ; 4 champions + Wisp: https://noxutft.com/guide/wisps , https://blitz.gg/tr/tft/articles/tft-set-18-wisps-guide
wisp_slot.note: When a Wisp is shown, the shop has 4 champions. Claim (unverified): a 5th champion is hidden behind the Wisp and appears if the Wisp is bought or when the round starts. For roll-downs the slot is treated as lost. On by default for Set 18.

inferno_upgrade.source: Inferno trait: shop slots roll one cost tier higher (esports.gg Set 18 overview); exact rule unknown

riftbeast_shop.source: Riftbeast (5): next shop overrun with Riftbeasts every few combats (esports.gg Set 18 overview); exact rule unknown

bad_luck_protection.source: parameter block seen in Set 11 game files (ACIK_KAYNAK_INCELEME.md 2.5); Set 18 status unknown
